plan.title: Recreate Order with Very Large Custom End Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Enable the buyer bid-editing configuration required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage named by the case.
Reach the Responses view where the closed RFQ bids are displayed.
Use the supported RFQ Settings action to open the Recreate Order window.
Confirm the Recreate Order window exposes the event-end duration control.
Choose the custom event-end duration mode.
Enter the very large custom duration specified by the case.
Set the future delivery date required before creating the order.
Submit the Recreate Order form with the large custom duration.
Assert that submission does not display an application error.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash, server error, or malformed values.
